name: Classmate 1
source:
A classmate who often hangs out with Mizu.

She's direct about her thoughts, and often plays the straight man to Mizu and Classmate 2.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401085609/http://www.sakuramint.net/tsugiteras/tsugi_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
